resource.description: Discharge summary following cardiac catheterisation admission March 2025
Referral to cardiology for chest pain evaluation
Scanned signed consent form for cardiac catheterisation

coding.display: CBC W Auto Differential panel + Metabolic Panel

resource.conclusion: Anaemia (iron deficiency pattern), poorly controlled diabetes (HbA1c 7.8%), hyperlipidaemia, renal function preserved.
Borderline cardiac silhouette. No acute cardiopulmonary disease.
Single-vessel CAD with 70% mid-LAD stenosis. LV function preserved (EF 55%). Medical management recommended.
Normal sinus rhythm with non-specific ST-T wave changes in V4-V6.

reasonCode.text: Admission for chest pain evaluation and cardiac catheterisation
